import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianH1
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivLocallyClosed
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivTwistFaithfulness
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianEvaluation
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PointRankSemicontinuity
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianCoherence
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleWholeFiber

/-!
# The universal Grassmannian candidate for a divisor

This file connects the D2 divisor-to-Grassmannian class to the D3
curve-side candidate quotient.  It is kept downstream of both constructions
so changes to this bridge do not force the large D2 development to recompile.

Reconstruction from a relatively generated twisted ideal specializes Nitsure,
*Construction of Hilbert and Quot Schemes*, Section 5, "Embedding Quot into
Grassmannian", to divisor families in the campaign's D2 construction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Scheme

/-- Properness of a morphism is preserved by base change, and therefore the
projection from a base-changed family is a closed map.  This is the topological
input for the Kleiman proper-image construction of the whole-fibre locus. -/
theorem isClosedMap_pullback_snd_of_isProper
    {S X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) [IsProper f] :
    IsClosedMap (pullback.snd f g).base := by
  haveI hp : UniversallyClosed f := IsProper.toUniversallyClosed
  haveI : UniversallyClosed (pullback.snd f g) := by
    exact universallyClosed_isStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g) hp
  exact Scheme.Hom.isClosedMap _

namespace DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}

/-- The reconstructed Grassmannian evaluation kills the relations of an
actual divisor family.  The proof is the adjunction transpose of
`kernel.ι (grassmannianEval L x) ≫ grassmannianEval L x = 0`; it uses no
additional hypothesis beyond the data already needed to form that quotient. -/
theorem grassmannianKernelEvaluation_comp_twistQuotientMap
    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
        (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree) ≫
      x.twistQuotientMap L = 0 := by
  let q := x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree
  change LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L q ≫
    x.twistQuotientMap L = 0
  apply ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (pullback.snd π T.hom)).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  simp only [LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change (kernel.ι q.q ≫
      (canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L) ≫
      (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
        (x.twistQuotientMap L) = _
  rw [Category.assoc]
  change kernel.ι q.q ≫ q.q = _
  rw [kernel.condition, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_zero]
  rfl

/-- The canonical comparison from the Grassmannian candidate cokernel to the
twisted sheaf of an actual divisor family. -/
noncomputable def grassmannianCandidateToTwist
    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    cokernel (LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
      (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree)) ⟶ x.twist L :=
  cokernel.desc _ (x.twistQuotientMap L)
    (grassmannianKernelEvaluation_comp_twistQuotientMap
      L x hEpi hLocFree)

/-- The candidate quotient followed by its comparison is the original
twisted divisor quotient. -/
theorem grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_candidateToTwist
    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L
        (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree) ≫
      grassmannianCandidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree =
        x.twistQuotientMap L :=
  cokernel.π_desc _ _ _

/-! The comparison is not merely a map out of the Grassmannian candidate: it
is an epimorphism onto the actual twisted divisor module.  This is the
categorical cancellation step used when the candidate is later identified
with the Cartier quotient. -/

/-- **The Grassmannian candidate comparison is epimorphic.**

The candidate quotient is epi by construction, and its composite with the
comparison is the original twisted divisor quotient, which is epi.  Cancelling
the first epi factor therefore proves that the comparison itself is epi. -/
theorem grassmannianCandidateToTwist_epi
    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    Epi (grassmannianCandidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree) := by
  let q := x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree
  let c := grassmannianCandidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree
  have hq : Epi (LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L q) :=
    LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient_epi L q
  have hcomp : Epi (LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L q ≫ c) := by
    rw [grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_candidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree]
    exact twistQuotientMap_epi_core L x
  exact (epi_comp_iff_of_epi (LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L q) c).mp hcomp

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Relative generation of the actual twisted divisor ideal reconstructs the
divisor quotient from its Grassmannian image.  The generation hypothesis is
epimorphy of the adjunction counit on the kernel of the twisted quotient.
The canonical base-change isomorphism identifies relative sections of the
twist with the source of the Grassmannian quotient.

This is the reconstruction step in the divisor-to-Grassmannian immersion;
uniform generation of the twisted ideals remains a separate geometric input. -/
theorem grassmannianCandidateToTwist_isIso_of_kernel_counit_epi
    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d)
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)]
    (hgen : Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)))) :
    IsIso (grassmannianCandidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree) := by
  let p := x.twistQuotientMap L
  let q := x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree
  let b : (Modules.pullback T.hom).obj ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) ⟶
      (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj
        ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L) :=
    (canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L
  let adj := Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (pullback.snd π T.hom)
  let e := LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L q
  let R := Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)
  let F := Modules.pullback (pullback.snd π T.hom)
  haveI : IsIso b := inferInstance
  haveI : Epi p := twistQuotientMap_epi_core L x
  haveI : Epi (adj.counit.app (kernel p)) := hgen
  have hq : q.q = b ≫ R.map p := rfl
  let k : R.obj (kernel p) ⟶ kernel q.q :=
    kernel.lift q.q (R.map (kernel.ι p) ≫ inv b) (by
      rw [hq]
      simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← R.map_comp,
        kernel.condition, Functor.map_zero])
  have hk : k ≫ kernel.ι q.q ≫ b = R.map (kernel.ι p) := by
    simp only [k, kernel.lift_ι_assoc, Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id,
      Category.comp_id]
  have he : F.map k ≫ e = adj.counit.app (kernel p) ≫ kernel.ι p := by
    dsimp only [e, LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation]
    rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm]
    change (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (k ≫ kernel.ι q.q ≫ b) = _
    rw [hk, Adjunction.homEquiv_counit]
    exact adj.counit.naturality (kernel.ι p)
  have hz : kernel.ι p ≫ cokernel.π e = 0 := by
    apply (cancel_epi (adj.counit.app (kernel p))).mp
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← he, Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero,
      comp_zero]
  let c := grassmannianCandidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree
  have hc : cokernel.π e ≫ c = p :=
    grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_candidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree
  let v := Abelian.epiDesc p (cokernel.π e) hz
  have hv : p ≫ v = cokernel.π e := Abelian.comp_epiDesc p _ hz
  change IsIso c
  refine ⟨⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · apply (cancel_epi (cokernel.π e)).mp
    rw [← Category.assoc, hc, hv, Category.comp_id]
  · apply (cancel_epi p).mp
    rw [← Category.assoc, hv, hc, Category.comp_id]

/-- The reconstruction isomorphism for a relatively generated twisted ideal. -/
noncomputable def grassmannianCandidateIsoTwistOfKernelCounitEpi
    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d)
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)]
    (hgen : Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)))) :
    cokernel (LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
      (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree)) ≅ x.twist L := by
  letI := grassmannianCandidateToTwist_isIso_of_kernel_counit_epi
    L x hEpi hLocFree hgen
  exact asIso (grassmannianCandidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree)

/-- The reconstructed isomorphism identifies the quotient maps, not just the
underlying modules. -/
theorem grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_isoTwist_hom
    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d)
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)]
    (hgen : Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)))) :
    LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L
        (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree) ≫
      (grassmannianCandidateIsoTwistOfKernelCounitEpi
        L x hEpi hLocFree hgen).hom = x.twistQuotientMap L :=
  grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_candidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The reconstructed Grassmannian candidate has an invertible kernel whenever
the original divisor quotient does.  Thus the reconstruction is compatible
with the rank-one locally closed locus used in the D3 construction. -/
theorem candidateIdeal_isLocallyTrivial_of_reconstruction
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d)
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)]
    (hgen : Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)))) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
      (LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal L
        (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree)) := by
  let q := x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree
  let e := grassmannianCandidateIsoTwistOfKernelCounitEpi
    L x hEpi hLocFree hgen
  let ek : kernel (LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L q) ≅
      kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L) :=
    kernel.mapIso (LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L q)
      (x.twistQuotientMap L) (Iso.refl _) e
      (grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_isoTwist_hom
        L x hEpi hLocFree hgen)
  exact LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial.of_iso ek.symm
    (x.twistQuotientKernel_isLocallyTrivial L hL)

/-! The preceding reconstruction theorem identifies the candidate ideal with
the Cartier kernel of an actual divisor family.  Record the finiteness data
that this supplies to the D3 factorisation API; these are properties of an
inhabited divisor family, rather than unconditional properties of the
universal candidate on the whole Grassmannian. -/

/-- The reconstructed candidate ideal is finitely presented. -/
theorem candidateIdeal_isFinitePresentation_of_reconstruction
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d)
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)]
    (hgen : Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)))) :
    (LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal L
      (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree)).IsFinitePresentation := by
  exact (candidateIdeal_isLocallyTrivial_of_reconstruction
    L hL x hEpi hLocFree hgen).isFinitePresentation

/-- The reconstructed candidate ideal is quasi-coherent. -/
theorem candidateIdeal_isQuasicoherent_of_reconstruction
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d)
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)]
    (hgen : Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)))) :
    (LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal L
      (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree)).IsQuasicoherent := by
  haveI : (LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal L
      (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    candidateIdeal_isFinitePresentation_of_reconstruction
      L hL x hEpi hLocFree hgen
  infer_instance

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The divisor-to-Grassmannian comparison is injective on families whose
twisted ideals are relatively generated.  Equality of Grassmannian classes
identifies the reconstructed quotients; their quotient-compatible
reconstruction isomorphisms and cancellation of the line-bundle twist then
identify the original divisor families.

This specializes the reconstruction argument of Nitsure, Section 5, to the
campaign's D2 divisor comparison.  Uniform production of the evaluation and
generation hypotheses is not asserted here. -/
theorem rel_of_grassmannianClass_eq_of_kernel_counit_epi
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x y : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    [QuasiCompact π] [QuasiSeparated π] [Flat T.hom] {d : ℕ}
    (hxEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hyEpi : Epi (y.grassmannianEval L))
    (hxLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d)
    (hyLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (y.twist L)) d)
    (hxgen : Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L))))
    (hygen : Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app (kernel (y.twistQuotientMap L))))
    (h : x.grassmannianClass L hxEpi hxLocFree =
      y.grassmannianClass L hyEpi hyLocFree) : x.Rel y := by
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : L.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom) L
  have hxy : (x.grassmannianQuotient L hxEpi hxLocFree).Rel
      (y.grassmannianQuotient L hyEpi hyLocFree) := Quotient.exact h
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient_rel L hxy
  let ex := grassmannianCandidateIsoTwistOfKernelCounitEpi L x hxEpi hxLocFree hxgen
  let ey := grassmannianCandidateIsoTwistOfKernelCounitEpi L y hyEpi hyLocFree hygen
  have hx : LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L
      (x.grassmannianQuotient L hxEpi hxLocFree) ≫ ex.hom =
      x.twistQuotientMap L :=
    grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_isoTwist_hom L x hxEpi hxLocFree hxgen
  have hy : LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L
      (y.grassmannianQuotient L hyEpi hyLocFree) ≫ ey.hom =
      y.twistQuotientMap L :=
    grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_isoTwist_hom L y hyEpi hyLocFree hygen
  apply rel_of_twistQuotientMap_iso L hL (ex.symm ≪≫ e ≪≫ ey)
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  rw [← hx, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← Category.assoc, he, hy]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Evaluation quotients descend from divisor representatives to a natural
map on the degree slice. Both the quotient relation and arbitrary base change
are respected by the canonical twisted evaluation. -/
noncomputable def grassmannianMap
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) (d : ℕ)
    (hEpi : ∀ (T : Over S) (x : DivFamily π T), x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hRank : ∀ (T : Over S) (x : DivFamily π T), x.HasFiberDeg d →
      SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
        ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    DivFunctorDeg π d ⟶ Grassmannian ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d := by
  classical
  let app : ∀ T, (DivFunctorDeg π d).obj T →
      (Grassmannian ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d).obj T := fun T z =>
    let hx : z.1.out.HasFiberDeg d := by
      change ClassHasFiberDeg d (Quotient.mk _ z.1.out)
      simpa only [Quotient.out_eq] using z.2
    z.1.out.grassmannianClass L (hEpi T.unop z.1.out hx) (hRank T.unop z.1.out hx)
  have happ (T : Over S) (x : DivFamily π T) (hx : x.HasFiberDeg d) :
      app (Opposite.op T) ⟨Quotient.mk _ x, hx⟩ =
        x.grassmannianClass L (hEpi T x hx) (hRank T x hx) := by
    exact grassmannianClass_eq_of_rel L
      (Quotient.exact (Quotient.out_eq (Quotient.mk (DivFamily.setoid π T) x))) _ _
  refine { app := fun T => TypeCat.ofHom (app T), naturality := ?_ }
  intro T T' f
  ext z
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := z
  induction z using Quotient.ind with
  | _ x =>
    change app T' ⟨Quotient.mk _ (x.pullbackAlong f.unop), _⟩ =
      (Grassmannian ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d).map f
        (app T ⟨Quotient.mk _ x, hz⟩)
    rw [happ, happ]
    exact (grassmannianClass_pullback_of_curve L hL x f.unop
      (hEpi T.unop x hz) (hRank T.unop x hz)).symm

@[simp]
theorem grassmannianMap_app_mk
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) (d : ℕ)
    (hEpi : ∀ (T : Over S) (x : DivFamily π T), x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hRank : ∀ (T : Over S) (x : DivFamily π T), x.HasFiberDeg d →
      SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
        ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d)
    (T : Over S) (x : DivFamily π T) (hx : x.HasFiberDeg d) :
    (grassmannianMap L hL d hEpi hRank).app (Opposite.op T)
        ⟨Quotient.mk _ x, hx⟩ =
      x.grassmannianClass L (hEpi T x hx) (hRank T x hx) := by
  exact grassmannianClass_eq_of_rel L
    (Quotient.exact (Quotient.out_eq (Quotient.mk (DivFamily.setoid π T) x))) _ _

/-- Relative generation of twisted divisor ideals makes the natural
Grassmannian comparison a monomorphism: reconstruction identifies the
quotients, and cancelling the invertible twist identifies the divisors. -/
theorem grassmannianMap_mono_of_kernel_counit_epi
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) (d : ℕ)
    (hEpi : ∀ (T : Over S) (x : DivFamily π T), x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    (hRank : ∀ (T : Over S) (x : DivFamily π T), x.HasFiberDeg d →
      SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
        ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d)
    (hFlat : ∀ T : Over S, Flat T.hom)
    (hgen : ∀ (T : Over S) (x : DivFamily π T), x.HasFiberDeg d →
      Epi ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (pullback.snd π T.hom)).counit.app
        (kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L)))) :
    Mono (grassmannianMap L hL d hEpi hRank) := by
  apply (NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app _).mpr
  intro T
  apply (CategoryTheory.mono_iff_injective _).mpr
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩ ⟨w, hw⟩ h
  induction z using Quotient.ind with
  | _ x =>
    induction w using Quotient.ind with
    | _ y =>
      haveI : Flat T.unop.hom := hFlat T.unop
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Quotient.sound
      apply rel_of_grassmannianClass_eq_of_kernel_counit_epi L hL x y
        (hEpi T.unop x hz) (hEpi T.unop y hw)
        (hRank T.unop x hz) (hRank T.unop y hw)
        (hgen T.unop x hz) (hgen T.unop y hw)
      change (grassmannianMap L hL d hEpi hRank).app (Opposite.op T.unop)
          ⟨Quotient.mk _ x, hz⟩ =
        (grassmannianMap L hL d hEpi hRank).app (Opposite.op T.unop)
          ⟨Quotient.mk _ y, hw⟩ at h
      exact (grassmannianMap_app_mk L hL d hEpi hRank T.unop x hz).symm.trans
        (h.trans (grassmannianMap_app_mk L hL d hEpi hRank T.unop y hw))

end DivFamily

namespace Grassmannian

variable {S X : Scheme.{0}} {π : X ⟶ S} [IsLocallyNoetherian S]

/-- The curve-side evaluation map attached to the universal quotient on the
chosen scheme representing `Grassmannian (π_* L) d`. -/
noncomputable def universalKernelEvaluation (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :=
  LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)

/-- The universal candidate quotient on
`X ×_S representingScheme (Grassmannian (π_*L) d)`. -/
noncomputable def universalCandidateQuotient (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :=
  LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L
    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)

/-- The kernel of the universal candidate quotient.  This is the actual
curve-side module whose invertible locus D3 must carve out; the kernel of the
Grassmannian quotient itself lives on the base and has the wrong rank.  Its
ordinary `lineBundleLocus` lies in the total space `X_G`; D3 must still descend
the whole-fibre condition to a locus in the Grassmannian base `G`. -/
noncomputable def universalCandidateIdeal (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :=
  LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal L
    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)

/-- The universal ideal is quasi-coherent on the entire universal curve;
no divisor reconstruction or relative flatness is assumed. -/
instance universalCandidateIdeal_isQuasicoherent
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsQuasicoherent] {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
    (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr).IsQuasicoherent := by
  haveI : ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent := hV.isQuasicoherent
  exact LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal_isQuasicoherent L
    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)

/-- The universal ideal is finitely presented before the locally closed
divisor locus is constructed. Over a field the local-noetherian hypothesis
is supplied by the Grassmannian and finite type of the curve. -/
instance universalCandidateIdeal_isFinitePresentation
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsFinitePresentation] {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)] :
    (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr).IsFinitePresentation := by
  haveI : ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent := hV.isQuasicoherent
  exact LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal_isFinitePresentation L
    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)

/-- The universal quotient supplies the coherent sheaf to which relative
flattening must be applied in D3. -/
instance universalCandidateCokernel_isFinitePresentation
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsFinitePresentation] {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)] :
    (cokernel (universalKernelEvaluation L hV hd hdr)).IsFinitePresentation := by
  haveI : ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent := hV.isQuasicoherent
  exact LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient_isFinitePresentation L
    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)

/-- The universal candidate is formed on the base-changed curve over the
Grassmannian representing scheme.  Its projection to the Grassmannian base is
therefore a closed map by properness of the original curve.  This named
specialization is the topological input consumed when descending the
curve-side rank-one condition to a whole-fibre base locus. -/
theorem universalCandidateProjection_isClosedMap (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
    [IsProper π]
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
    IsClosedMap
      (pullback.snd π (Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom).base :=
  isClosedMap_pullback_snd_of_isProper π
    (Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom

/-- The projection of the universal candidate's rank-superlevel locus is
closed on the Grassmannian base. This excludes rank at least two, but does
not exclude rank zero or supply relative flatness of the candidate quotient. -/
theorem universalCandidate_badRank_image_isClosed (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
    [IsProper π] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian
      (pullback π (Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)] :
    IsClosed ((pullback.snd π (Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom).base ''
      {z : (pullback π (Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom : Scheme) |
        1 + 1 ≤ Modules.pointRank _
          (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr) z}) := by
  apply universalCandidateProjection_isClosedMap L hV hd hdr
  exact Modules.isClosed_le_pointRank (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr) 1

/-- The open part of the Grassmannian base over which the actual universal
candidate ideal is invertible on the entire curve. This uses the open
invertibility locus, not the locally closed rank-one flattening stratum.
Relative flatness of the candidate quotient and degree control remain
necessary to construct the divisor scheme. The construction must be applied
again after flattening: arbitrary divisor tests need not land in this
ambient open. -/
noncomputable def universalCandidateInvertibleOpen (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
    [IsProper π]
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) : (representingScheme hV hd hdr).left.Opens :=
  Modules.wholeFiberLineBundleOpen
    (pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)
    (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)

/-- The candidate ideal becomes invertible over the universal restriction
to the constructed Grassmannian base open, without an invertibility premise. -/
theorem universalCandidateInvertibleOpen_isLocallyTrivial
    (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ} [IsProper π]
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
      ((Modules.pullback
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)
          (universalCandidateInvertibleOpen L hV hd hdr).ι)).obj
        (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)) :=
  Modules.wholeFiberLineBundleOpen_isLocallyTrivial _ _

/-- Maximality of the candidate's whole-fibre invertibility open on the
Grassmannian base. This is the proper-image step of Kleiman `th:repDiv`,
before imposing relative flatness and the prescribed divisor degree. -/
theorem le_universalCandidateInvertibleOpen_iff
    (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ} [IsProper π]
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    (V : (representingScheme hV hd hdr).left.Opens) :
    V ≤ universalCandidateInvertibleOpen L hV hd hdr ↔
      LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
        ((Modules.pullback
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom) V.ι)).obj
          (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)) :=
  Modules.le_wholeFiberLineBundleOpen_iff _ _ V

/-- The restricted universal quotient itself has invertible kernel.
Open restriction preserves kernels, so this is the actual Cartier-kernel
condition on the restricted quotient, not just invertibility of a separate
pulled-back module. -/
theorem universalCandidateInvertibleOpen_quotientKernel_isLocallyTrivial
    (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ} [IsProper π]
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
      (kernel ((Modules.pullback
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)
          (universalCandidateInvertibleOpen L hV hd hdr).ι)).map
        (universalCandidateQuotient L hV hd hdr))) := by
  exact LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial.of_iso (PreservesKernel.iso _ _)
    (universalCandidateInvertibleOpen_isLocallyTrivial L hV hd hdr)

/-- Flat tests of the Grassmannian factor through the constructed open
exactly when the pulled-back universal candidate ideal is invertible.
Arbitrary tests require relative flattening before this argument applies. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor_universalCandidateInvertibleOpen_iff_of_flat
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsFinitePresentation] {r d : ℕ} [IsProper π]
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)]
    {T : Scheme} (g : T ⟶ (representingScheme hV hd hdr).left) [Flat g] :
    (∃! l : T ⟶ (universalCandidateInvertibleOpen L hV hd hdr).toScheme,
      l ≫ (universalCandidateInvertibleOpen L hV hd hdr).ι = g) ↔
      LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
        ((Modules.pullback
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd π (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom) g)).obj
          (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)) :=
  Modules.existsUnique_factor_wholeFiberLineBundleOpen_iff_of_flat _ _ g

/-! The rank-one locus of the universal candidate ideal is the canonical
locally closed curve-side locus available before the whole-fibre descent to
the Grassmannian base. Its coherence is supplied by the universal construction. -/

/-- The curve-side rank-one locus cut out by the universal candidate ideal. -/
noncomputable def universalCandidateLineBundleLocus (L : X.Modules)
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
    Scheme :=
  Modules.lineBundleLocus (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)

/-- The universal candidate rank-one locus immerses into the universal curve. -/
instance universalCandidateLineBundleLocus_isImmersion (L : X.Modules)
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
    IsImmersion
      (Modules.lineBundleLocusι (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)) :=
  inferInstance

/-- The universal candidate ideal is invertible after restricting to its
rank-one locus.  This is the curve-side half of the D3 candidate-locus
construction; descending the whole-fibre condition to the Grassmannian base
remains separate. -/
theorem universalCandidateLineBundleLocus_isLocallyTrivial (L : X.Modules)
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
      ((Modules.pullback
        (Modules.lineBundleLocusι (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr))).obj
        (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)) :=
  Modules.lineBundleLocus_isLocallyTrivial
    (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)

/-- The curve-side Cartier locus carries the expected fibre-rank certificate.

This is the rank-one input needed when the locus is pushed down to the
Grassmannian base in the D3 whole-fibre descent: at every point of the
locally closed locus, the universal candidate ideal has fibre dimension one.
The statement is deliberately on the universal curve; it does not identify
the image in the Grassmannian base or claim arbitrary divisor coverage. -/
theorem universalCandidateLineBundleLocus_pointRank_eq_one (L : X.Modules)
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) (z : universalCandidateLineBundleLocus L hV hd hdr) :
    Modules.pointRank
        (pullback π (Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)
        (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)
        ((Modules.lineBundleLocusι (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)).base z) = 1 := by
  let ι := Modules.lineBundleLocusι (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)
  haveI : ((Modules.pullback ι).obj
      (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom ι
      (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr) inferInstance
  rw [← Modules.pointRank_pullback
    (Modules.lineBundleLocusι (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr))
    (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr) z]
  exact Modules.pointRank_eq_one_of_isLocallyTrivial
    (universalCandidateLineBundleLocus_isLocallyTrivial L hV hd hdr) z

/-- A flat family whose pulled-back universal candidate ideal is invertible
factors uniquely through the universal candidate's rank-one locus. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor_universalCandidateLineBundleLocus
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsFinitePresentation] {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian
      (pullback π (Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)]
    {T : Scheme} (φ : T ⟶ pullback π (Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom)
    (hline : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
      ((Modules.pullback φ).obj (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr))) :
    ∃! l : T ⟶ universalCandidateLineBundleLocus L hV hd hdr,
      l ≫ Modules.lineBundleLocusι (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr) = φ :=
  Modules.existsUnique_factor_lineBundleLocus_of_isLocallyTrivial
    (universalCandidateIdeal L hV hd hdr) φ hline

/-- The universal candidate quotient is epimorphic by its cokernel
construction. -/
theorem universalCandidateQuotient_epi (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
    Epi (universalCandidateQuotient L hV hd hdr) :=
  LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient_epi L
    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)

end Grassmannian

end Scheme

namespace Adelic

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- One tensor power reconstructs every degree-`d` divisor family over an
arbitrary test scheme from its Grassmannian quotient. Evaluation,
rank and generation are all produced from the curve and divisor hypotheses.
This is the divisor specialization of Nitsure's Section 5 reconstruction,
which supplies the comparison needed for Kleiman's divisor scheme. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_reconstruction
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
      (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T),
      x.HasFiberDeg d →
      ∃ (heval : Epi (x.grassmannianEval
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))
        (hrank : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom T.hom)).obj
            (x.twist (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n))) d),
        IsIso (Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianCandidateToTwist
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n) x heval hrank) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_and_kernel_counit_epi C d
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro T x hx
  let L := Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n
  have hL : Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L :=
    Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n
  obtain ⟨heval, hgen⟩ := hn T x hx
  have hrank := Scheme.DivFamily.pushforward_twist_isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_curve_arbitrary
    L hL x hx
  refine ⟨heval, hrank, ?_⟩
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : L.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom T.hom)).app L) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom T.hom) L
  exact Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianCandidateToTwist_isIso_of_kernel_counit_epi
    L x heval hrank hgen

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A single twist embeds the degree-`d` divisor functor into the Grassmannian
on the whole category of test schemes. The component formula identifies this
monomorphism with the canonical twisted evaluation quotient.

This is the divisor specialization of Nitsure, Section 5, "Embedding Quot
into Grassmannian", used in campaign D2 toward Kleiman's `th:repDiv`.
The locally closed image and the representing divisor scheme are subsequent
constructions. No rational point or representability is assumed. -/
theorem d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_grassmannian_mono
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ f : Scheme.DivFunctorDeg C.hom d ⟶
      Scheme.Grassmannian ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) d,
      Mono f ∧ ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
        (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T) (hx : x.HasFiberDeg d),
        ∃ (heval : Epi (x.grassmannianEval
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))
          (hrank : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom T.hom)).obj
              (x.twist (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n))) d),
          f.app (Opposite.op T) ⟨Quotient.mk _ x, hx⟩ =
            x.grassmannianClass (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
              heval hrank := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_and_kernel_counit_epi C d
  let L := Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n
  have hL : Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L :=
    Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n
  let heval : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T),
      x.HasFiberDeg d → Epi (x.grassmannianEval L) := fun T x hx => (hn T x hx).1
  let hrank : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T),
      x.HasFiberDeg d → SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d :=
    fun _ x hx => Scheme.DivFamily.pushforward_twist_isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_curve_arbitrary
      L hL x hx
  refine ⟨n, Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianMap L hL d heval hrank, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianMap_mono_of_kernel_counit_epi L hL d heval hrank
      (fun _ => inferInstance) (fun T x hx => (hn T x hx).2)
  · intro T x hx
    exact ⟨heval T x hx, hrank T x hx,
      Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianMap_app_mk L hL d heval hrank T x hx⟩

end Adelic
